channel.title: Mehmet Kahya — Writing
channel.description: Technical deep dives into Mehmet Kahya's open-source projects.

item.title: Chain Prompt: driving Claude Code with its own hooks
item.description: How I built an Electron app that queues prompts for the real interactive claude CLI and advances the chain from Claude Code's own lifecycle hooks, not from guessing at terminal output.

item.title: Subtitles that follow you into Picture-in-Picture
item.description: Native PiP only takes the raw video element, so YouTube's captions stay behind. This Chrome extension uses the Document Picture-in-Picture API to render synced subtitles inside the floating window.

item.title: Streaming Windows audio to a HomePod
item.description: Apple doesn't make AirPlay senders for Windows, so I built one in Python: WASAPI loopback capture, a jitter buffer, an endless WAV stream and a reconnecting RAOP session through pyatv.

item.title: AI Catalog: a README that became a website
item.description: My most-starred project is a curated list of 500+ AI tools across 40+ categories. Here is how it stays maintainable, and how a zero-build website turns the README itself into a searchable catalog.

item.title: TempMail: a disposable inbox in vanilla JavaScript
item.description: How TempMail turns the Guerrilla Mail API into a fast, multi-inbox web app with no framework and no backend, and what it takes to safely render emails from strangers in the browser.

item.title: Predicting F1 races with simulation, ML and real telemetry
item.description: Inside my F1 race predictor: a lap-by-lap stochastic simulator with tyre and weather models, a three-model scikit-learn ensemble, and FastF1 data blended into one prediction.

item.title: A LAN webcam with WebRTC and Socket.IO
item.description: Turning any device into a wireless camera on your local network: rooms and signaling with Socket.IO, peer-to-peer video with WebRTC, live connection stats, and the lessons I'd apply if I rebuilt it today.

item.title: A 140-line scraper, and what I'd fix today
item.description: Web Resource Downloader grabs images, scripts and media from a website with requests and BeautifulSoup. A walkthrough of how it works, plus an honest code review of my own older code.
